versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "外卖领券" skill for accessing food delivery coupons.
- Supports natural language queries (e.g., "领券", "美团领券", "饿了么优惠").
- Provides platform-specific or combined links for 美团, 饿了么, and 京东外卖.
- Delivers markdown coupon links via direct HTTP endpoint requests, with no external dependencies.
- Automatically handles request retries and paginated results.
